title: F41 · useless · "Let Me Do It, Dadi"
lines: n
Let me do it, Dadi. It is faster.
"Let me do it, Dadi. It is faster."
n
The phone. The gas booking. The TV remote with forty buttons.
n
She raised four children and ran a house on one salary.
Now she cannot pay the milkman.
n
She has started saying, What do I know. I am old.
She has started saying, "What do I know. I am old."
n
That evening Pari had a question no phone could answer.
n
Dadi did not explain. She just held her, and was quiet, until the question got smaller.
n
Kabir was watching from the door. He looked at the phone in his hand.
n
He sat down beside her. Dadi. Teach me the thing you just did.
He sat down beside her. "Dadi. Teach me the thing you just did."
First, she said, show me this UPI. Slowly.
"First," she said, "show me this UPI. Slowly."
n
Some knowledge is fast. The other kind takes seventy years. That is sadhana.
n
